context: A police officer discusses a case
purpose: Teach: 尋常/行き着く/電報/航路/探知/重傷/覇権/代議士

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、尋常ではない、絶対、状況、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: This case is serious. We're proceeding with careful investigation. Thank you for your patience.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Even pacing. Opens with calm authority. Closes with respect—not gratitude-seeking, but acknowledging the weight of the matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 捜査が、本気で、絶対、最終的に、絶対、行き着く、絶対、結論、絶対、知りたいですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I'd like to know what the investigation will ultimately conclude.
lines.style: Genuine intellectual curiosity. Leaning forward slightly in the voice. Thoughtful pause before the final phrase—not impatient, just engaged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。昔の事件、本気で、絶対、電報、絶対、証拠として、絶対、残っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We have old case evidence—telegrams—that are still on record.
lines.style: Procedural and direct. Even delivery. Each fact lands with quiet weight. No inflection seeking agreement, just presenting information.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、本気で、絶対、航路を、絶対、変えて、絶対、逃げた、絶対、と、聞きました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard the suspect changed route and fled.
lines.style: Careful, seeking confirmation. Slight lift at the end—not quite a question, but inviting elaboration. Listening quality in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。最新の探知機、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、活用しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're using the latest detection equipment in the investigation.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact. Slight emphasis on 'latest'—reassurance without overselling. Steady, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者、本気で、絶対、重傷、絶対、ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.style: Quiet heaviness. Not dwelled upon, but not rushed past either. Respect for the gravity. Brief, intentional silence after the statement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。組織の覇権、本気で、絶対、犯罪、絶対、関係していることも、絶対、捜査、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're also investigating possible links between this case and organized crime activity.
lines.style: Methodical unwinding of complexity. Each part clearly separated. Calm but thorough—the voice of someone who leaves no stone unturned.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 代議士、本気で、絶対、本件、絶対、関与、絶対、ないことを、絶対、願います、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I hope the Diet member has no involvement in this.
lines.style: Quiet hope mixed with wariness. Slow, careful phrasing—choosing words with precision. The trailing end softer, almost vulnerable, before closing with composed restraint.
